away.name: Jake Allen
away.news: Allen will start Tuesday in Detroit.

home.name: John Gibson
home.news: Gibson had a tremendous inaugural season with the Red Wings in 2025-26, nearly leading them to a postseason berth, but 2026-27 has started rocky for the team, including Gibson. The 33-year-old American goalie had a brutal previous outing, allowing five goals on 15 shots (.667 SV%) in a 6-3 loss to the Seattle Kraken. He has a 3.43 GAA and .862 SV% in four games this season (1-3-0). The Red Wings enter Tuesday's contest at home with -105 odds against a New Jersey Devils team that lost 4-1 to the Ottawa Senators last night.

away.name: Akira Schmid
away.news: Jacob Markstrom exited yesterday's 5-3 loss to the Buffalo Sabres early in the second period for precautionary reasons and was replaced by Akira Schmid, who saved 18 of 21 shots (.857 SV%) in the losing effort. The 26-year-old Schmid hasn't been tested much this season, and will likely start for just the second time. The Panthers enter Tuesday's contest as +109 road underdogs against the 2-2-0 Columbus Blue Jackets.

home.name: Cam Talbot
home.news: Jet Greaves has struggled early in the 2026-27 season, allowing veteran Cam Talbot to make his case for more playing time in his second start on Tuesday against the Florida Panthers. The 39-year-old Talbot was solid in his only outing this season, saving 20 of 22 shots (.909 SV%) in a 3-2 shootout victory over the Pittsburgh Penguins. The Blue Jackets enter Tuesday's contest as -121 home favourites against a Panthers team that has scored only 12 goals in its first six games (2-2-2).

home.name: Jacob Fowler
home.news: Samuel Montembeault's disastrous 2025-26 season, which led to a demotion to the AHL, thrust Fowler into NHL action, but Montembeault started the 2026-27 season with the Canadiens, so Fowler played with Laval (AHL). That said, an early-season injury to Montembeault has given Fowler an NHL opportunity, and he has thrived in a small early-season sample. The 21-year-old Fowler stopped all 30 shots in his most recent outing, recording a shutout in a 1-0 shootout win over the Detroit Red Wings. The Canadiens enter Tuesday's contest as -153 home favourites against a Buffalo Sabres team that improved to 3-3-0 yesterday after defeating the Florida Panthers 5-3.

home.name: Dylan Garand
home.news: With Igor Shesterkin (lower body) out for the season, and Joonas Korpisalo (lower body) still several weeks away from returning, Garand has been thrust into the spotlight for the Rangers. The 24-year-old goalie cleared waivers earlier this season, but now thrives as the Rangers' de facto starter. Garand saved 19 of 21 shots (.905 SV%) in his previous outing, a 6-2 win over the Vancouver Canucks to improve to 2-1-0 with a 1.20 GAA and .945 SV% this season. The Rangers enter Tuesday's contest as +144 home underdogs against the Tampa Bay Lightning, who are riding a four-game winning streak.

home.name: Ilya Sorokin
home.news: The Islanders are off to a subpar 2-3-0 start this season, but can't fault Sorokin, who has been tremendous between the pipes. The 31-year-old Russian goalie boasts an outstanding 1.77 GAA, .937 SV%, and one shutout in four games this season (2-2-0). He hasn't posted a save percentage above .909 since the 2022-23 season, when he finished as the runner-up for the Vezina Trophy. The Islanders enter Tuesday's contest as sizeable -214 home favourites against a Vancouver Canucks team that has been outscored 35-24 through seven games (2-5-0).

away.name: Calvin Pickard
away.news: With Filip Gustavsson (hip) sidelined, Minnesota has started Jesper Wallstedt in every game of the 2026-27 season, but Pickard will get his first chance on Tuesday in the tail end of a back-to-back. The 34-year-old Pickard has had some success at the NHL level, but struggled in limited action in 2025-26, posting a 3.68 GAA and .871 SV% in 16 games (5-6-2) with the Edmonton Oilers.

home.name: Stuart Skinner
home.news: Skinner has been stellar early in his tenure with the Jets and will return to the crease on Tuesday against the Minnesota Wild. The 27-year-old goalie was outstanding in his most recent outing, saving 32 of 34 shots (.941 SV%) in a 3-2 win over the Colorado Avalanche. Skinner has a 2.62 GAA and .920 SV% in three games (2-0-1) this season. The Jets enter Tuesday's contest as slight -108 home favourites against a Wild team off to a strong 4-1-1 start.

away.name: Mackenzie Blackwood
away.news: Colorado Head Coach Jared Bednar criticized Blackwood after a 6-3 loss to the Toronto Maple Leafs for failing to make a timely save, but he will turn to him again on Tuesday against the Dallas Stars. Surprisingly, Blackwood has started four of five games for Colorado this season, going 2-2-0, posting a 3.30 GAA and .867 SV%.

away.name: Adin Hill
away.news: Hill is expected to start Tuesday in Nashville.
